title: Pilot: migrate Distinctive Mark onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Distinctive Mark is live on the standard front end: https://distinctive-mark.com serves / (200 text/html), /feed.xml and /atom.xml (200, 18 unique ids), /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /index.md (text/markdown). Accept: text/markdown was the one gap: the hand-run papyrus-edge-distinctive-mark stack's viewer function did not negotiate; fixed today by change set accept-markdown (Distinctive-web PR #1); now Accept: text/markdown on / and /about/ returns 200 text/markdown, browsers still get text/html.
